identification: Rectangular pine/lime panel, 89 x 30 cm, with a sunken field carved in relief: a farmer in hat and boots guiding a single-furrow wheeled plough pulled by a draught horse, with a bundled sack on the beam, an Alpine chalet behind, dark-stained background and natural-finish figures. Hanging wire on top. Alpine (Bavarian, Tyrolean or Swiss) souvenir/decorator carving, mid to late 20th century, unsigned in the photo. Cloud scan correct.
